notes: A DeepSeek Harness model request fails after turn/start. DSH persists an explicit error turn/end rather than a successful boundary. The adapter maps the boundary to turn_done plus a terminal SessionError, so the correct four-state arc is ready -> working -> error, not the scenario's older generic ready settle. The error remains visible until a later user turn; this recipe sends no recovery turn. The dead loopback endpoint makes the provider failure deterministic and consumes no model tokens. Recording review must confirm the error names a connection or transport failure, because the phase DSL cannot distinguish that cause from another terminal error.
source: replaydata/agents/scenarios.json -> turn-aborted-by-error, specialized for DSH's structured terminal failure

text: The post-marker DSH session appears in ready after TUI launch
The session.lock writer binds the running DSH process to the session
The real user prompt and turn/start drive the session to working before the provider failure
The provider call fails and DSH writes an error turn/end; the session moves from working to error and stays there for at least 10 seconds without silently returning to ready or waiting
